attribution: Original LingoLearn graded texts, sentence explanations, comprehension questions and word definitions. Synthetic audio is attributed separately.

sentences.text: I go to the market on Saturday.

explanation.en: The present simple describes a routine; on marks a day.
explanation.zh: 我星期六去市场。

sentences.text: A woman sells fresh bread near the entrance.

explanation.en: Sells agrees with the singular subject a woman.
explanation.zh: 一位女士在入口附近卖新鲜面包。

sentences.text: I buy two apples and a small loaf of bread.

explanation.en: Two counts the apples; loaf gives a unit for bread.
explanation.zh: 我买两个苹果和一小条面包。

sentences.text: Then I walk home with my brother.

explanation.en: Then orders the events. With introduces the companion.
explanation.zh: 然后我和哥哥步行回家。

questions.prompt: When does the speaker visit the market?
What does the speaker buy?
Where does the woman sell bread?
How many apples does the speaker buy?
Who walks home with the speaker?
What happens after the speaker buys the food?
choices: The speaker takes a bus to the market

meaning.en: a place where people buy and sell goods
the place where you go into a building or area
a whole shaped piece of bread

sentences.text: We were waiting for a train when the station announced a delay.

explanation.en: The past continuous gives the background; the simple past interrupts it.
explanation.zh: 我们正在等火车，这时车站宣布列车晚点。

sentences.text: Our guide had already booked a walking tour for that afternoon.

explanation.en: The past perfect places the booking before the delay.
explanation.zh: 导游已经预订了当天下午的步行游览。

sentences.text: She called the museum and moved our visit to the following morning.

explanation.en: The following morning is the morning after that afternoon.
explanation.zh: 她给博物馆打电话，把参观改到了第二天早上。

sentences.text: Although we arrived late, we still had time to explore the old town.

explanation.en: Although introduces a concession; still shows the opportunity remained.
explanation.zh: 虽然到得晚，我们仍有时间逛老城区。

questions.prompt: Why did the group change its plan?
When would they visit the museum?
What had the guide already arranged for that afternoon?
Who called the museum?
What were the travellers doing when they heard about the delay?
Which activity did the group still have time for after arriving late?
choices: Finishing a tour before the delay was announced
Visiting the museum that same morning

meaning.en: a situation in which something happens later than planned
to travel around a place to learn about it

title.en: Who benefits from a new park?

sentences.text: The council proposed turning an unused car park into a public garden.

explanation.en: Proposed turning uses an -ing form after propose.
explanation.zh: 市政委员会提议把闲置停车场改成公共花园。

sentences.text: While most residents welcomed the idea, several shopkeepers feared that fewer parking spaces would reduce sales.

explanation.en: While introduces a contrast between supporters and concerned shopkeepers.
explanation.zh: 大多数居民欢迎这个想法，但一些店主担心车位减少会影响销售。

sentences.text: Had the council consulted them earlier, it might have avoided some of the opposition.

explanation.en: Had the council consulted is an inverted past unreal condition.
explanation.zh: 如果委员会早些征询他们的意见，或许能避免部分反对。

sentences.text: The revised proposal therefore includes a delivery area and a trial period, after which local businesses will be consulted again.

explanation.en: After which links the trial period to the later consultation.
explanation.zh: 因此修订方案加入了卸货区和试行期，之后将再次征询当地商家的意见。

questions.prompt: What concern did some shopkeepers express?
choices: Reduced sales because of fewer parking spaces
Too many public gardens already existing
The cost of planting their own trees

questions.prompt: Why does the revised plan include a trial period?
choices: To stop residents entering the garden
To allow the plan to be assessed before another consultation
To guarantee that every business will profit

questions.prompt: What was the proposed garden site used for previously?
How does the passage describe most residents' initial reaction?
choices: They asked to keep every parking space

questions.prompt: What does the sentence beginning 'Had the council consulted them earlier' imply?
choices: Earlier consultation might have reduced some opposition
Earlier consultation would certainly have removed every objection

questions.prompt: Which addition directly addresses access for supplying local businesses?
choices: A ban on all vehicles in the district
A rule closing every shop during the trial

meaning.en: to ask for information or opinions before deciding
disagreement with a plan or proposal
a plan put forward for consideration

sentences.text: 我叫小安，是学生。

explanation.en: My name is Xiao An, and I am a student. 是 introduces an identity.
explanation.zh: 小安介绍自己的名字和身份。

sentences.text: 今天下午，我和朋友去图书馆。

explanation.en: This afternoon, my friend and I go to the library. 和 joins the two people.
explanation.zh: “今天下午”说明时间，“和”连接两个人。

sentences.text: 我借了两本书，朋友借了一本词典。

explanation.en: I borrowed two books, and my friend borrowed a dictionary. 本 counts bound books.
explanation.zh: 书和词典都用量词“本”。

sentences.text: 我们五点回家。

explanation.en: We go home at five. 五点 gives the time.
explanation.zh: “五点”说明回家的时间。

questions.prompt: 小安是什么人？
朋友借了什么？
小安什么时候去图书馆？
小安和谁一起去图书馆？
小安自己借了几本书？
他们几点回家？

sentences.text: 上个月，我在网上给朋友买了一件外套。

explanation.en: Last month I bought a coat online for a friend. 给 identifies the recipient.
explanation.zh: “给朋友”说明受益者，“了”标记已经完成的购买。

sentences.text: 朋友以前来过我的城市，但是没去过那家店。

explanation.en: My friend has visited my city before, but has never been to that shop. 过 marks experience.
explanation.zh: “过”表示经历，“没去过”表示没有这段经历。

sentences.text: 收到外套以后，他发现袖子比自己的旧外套长一点儿。

explanation.en: After receiving the coat, he found its sleeves slightly longer than those of his old coat. 比 marks comparison.
explanation.zh: “比……长一点儿”表示小幅度的比较。

sentences.text: 我把订单发给他，让他联系商店换一个尺码。

explanation.en: I sent him the order so he could contact the shop to exchange it for another size. 把 highlights what happens to the order.
explanation.zh: “把订单发给他”突出订单的处理结果。

questions.prompt: 朋友觉得外套哪里不合适？
为什么发订单给朋友？
choices: 方便他联系商店换尺码

questions.prompt: 说话人在哪里买的外套？
说话人是什么时候买外套的？
朋友以前的经历是什么？
choices: 去过那家店，但没来过这个城市
来过这个城市，但没去过那家店

questions.prompt: 朋友收到外套之后先发现了什么？
choices: 新外套的袖子比旧外套长一点儿

meaning.zh: 穿在其他衣服外面的衣服
衣服套在手臂上的部分

sentences.text: 虽然新修的道路让出行更方便，但是附近居民也开始抱怨夜间噪声。

explanation.en: Although the new road makes travel easier, nearby residents have begun complaining about night-time noise. 虽然…但是… expresses concession.
explanation.zh: “虽然……但是……”连接便利与噪声这两个相反的方面。

sentences.text: 这些意见不都针对车辆数量，有些居民更关心施工时间。

explanation.en: Not all these concerns are about the number of vehicles; some residents care more about construction times. 不都 is a partial negation.
explanation.zh: “不都”表示部分否定，不等于所有意见都不针对车流。

sentences.text: 社区决定，无论工程进度如何，都不得在夜间进行高噪声作业。

explanation.en: The community decided that noisy work must never take place at night, regardless of construction progress. 无论…都… makes the rule unconditional.
explanation.zh: “无论……都……”说明规则不因进度改变。

sentences.text: 原来的施工安排被重新调整，居民也可以每周查看后续计划。

explanation.en: The original construction schedule was revised, and residents can inspect future plans weekly. 被 marks the affected schedule.
explanation.zh: “被”字句说明原有安排受到调整。

questions.prompt: 居民的意见是否都针对车辆数量？
choices: 不是，有些针对施工时间

questions.prompt: 夜间高噪声作业在什么情况下可以进行？
新道路带来的好处是什么？
choices: 所有车辆都不再经过社区
夜间施工完全没有声音

questions.prompt: 居民多久可以查看一次后续计划？
文中的施工安排后来怎么样了？
choices: 被全部取消，工程不再进行

questions.prompt: 哪项最准确地概括了社区的回应？
choices: 限制夜间高噪声作业，并让居民查看后续计划
只统计车辆，保持原施工时间不变

meaning.zh: 不需要的、可能令人不适的声音

sentences.text: 私は大学生です。

explanation.en: I am a university student. です makes the identity statement polite.
explanation.zh: “です”用于礼貌地介绍身份。

sentences.text: 日曜日に友達と公園に行きます。

explanation.en: On Sunday I go to the park with a friend. に marks the time and destination; と means with.
explanation.zh: “に”标记时间和目的地，“と”表示同行者。

sentences.text: 公園で写真を撮ります。

explanation.en: I take photographs in the park. で marks where the action happens.
explanation.zh: “で”标记拍照这个动作发生的地点。

sentences.text: その後、近くの店で昼ご飯を食べます。

explanation.en: After that, I eat lunch at a nearby shop. その後 means after that.
explanation.zh: “その後”表示“那之后”，句末保持礼貌形式。

questions.prompt: どこで写真を撮りますか。
写真を撮った後、何をしますか。
話している人の身分は何ですか。
何曜日に公園に行きますか。
誰と公園に行きますか。
昼ご飯を食べる店はどこにありますか。

sentences.text: 今、駅で友達を待っています。

explanation.en: I am waiting for a friend at the station now. ている describes an ongoing action.
explanation.zh: “待っています”表示正在等候。

sentences.text: 友達はこの町に来たことがありますが、美術館には行ったことがありません。

explanation.en: My friend has visited this town before but has never visited its art museum. たことがある expresses experience.
explanation.zh: “たことがある”表示有过的经历；否定形式表示没有这段经历。

sentences.text: バスより電車のほうが速いので、電車で行くことにしました。

explanation.en: We decided to take the train because it is faster than the bus. より and ほう compare; ので gives the reason.
explanation.zh: 比较结构说明电车更快，“ので”引出选择的原因。

sentences.text: 雨が降っているので、駅からは地下通路を使います。

explanation.en: Because it is raining, we will use the underground passage from the station. The reason comes before ので.
explanation.zh: 正在下雨是选择地下通道的原因。

questions.prompt: 友達が行ったことがない場所はどこですか。
どうして電車を選びましたか。
話している人は今、何をしていますか。
choices: 駅で友達を待っています
美術館で絵を見ています
バスで家に帰っています

questions.prompt: 地下通路を使う理由は何ですか。
choices: 友達が地下で働いているから
地上の道が完全になくなったから

questions.prompt: 友達の経験について正しいものはどれですか。
choices: この町に来るのは初めてです
この町には以前来たことがあります
この美術館には何度も来ています

questions.prompt: 二つの移動手段について、本文と合う組み合わせはどれですか。
choices: 歩いて町に入り、駅からバスに乗ります
電車で行き、駅から地下通路を使います
バスで行き、駅から船に乗ります

sentences.text: 私が知っている限り、この祭りが中止されたことはありませんでした。

explanation.en: As far as I know, this festival had never been cancelled. 限り limits the claim to the speaker’s knowledge.
explanation.zh: “知っている限り”限定判断所依据的知识范围。

sentences.text: しかし、今年は大雨にもかかわらず開催するべきか、意見が分かれました。

explanation.en: This year, however, opinions differed about whether to hold it despite the heavy rain. にもかかわらず introduces an unexpected contrast.
explanation.zh: “にもかかわらず”表示逆接：即使有大雨这一不利情况。

sentences.text: 参加者全員が延期に反対しているわけではありません。

explanation.en: Not all participants oppose postponement. わけではありません gives a partial negation here.
explanation.zh: “わけではありません”在这里表示部分否定。

sentences.text: 川の水位が上がったため、実行委員会は安全を優先して延期せざるを得ませんでした。

explanation.en: As the river level rose, the committee had no choice but to postpone it for safety. せざるを得ない expresses an unavoidable decision.
explanation.zh: “せざるを得ない”表示没有别的办法，只能延期。

questions.prompt: 延期が決まった主な理由は何ですか。
choices: 川の水位が上がり、安全を優先したため
全員が祭りに反対したため
去年も中止されたため

questions.prompt: 参加者の意見について正しいものはどれですか。
choices: 全員が延期を希望しています
延期に反対していない人もいます
全員が延期に反対しています

questions.prompt: 今年、どのような点で意見が分かれましたか。
choices: 祭りの名前を変更するべきか
川に新しい橋を造るべきか
大雨でも祭りを開催するべきか

questions.prompt: 最終的に、委員会は祭りをどうすることにしましたか。
choices: 予定どおり必ず開催する

questions.prompt: 「私が知っている限り」は、最初の文にどんな意味を加えていますか。
choices: 過去の記録がすべて完全だと保証しています
今年は絶対に延期しないと約束しています
過去の状況について、話し手の知識の範囲を示しています

questions.prompt: 「延期せざるを得ませんでした」は、決定をどのように説明していますか。
choices: 雨がやんだので、延期の必要がなくなった
参加者全員が望んだので、自由に日程を選んだ
安全上の事情から、延期するしかなかった

sentences.text: 저는 한국어를 배우는 학생이에요.

explanation.en: I am a student learning Korean. 학생이에요 is a polite identity statement.
explanation.zh: “학생이에요”用礼貌形式介绍学生身份。

sentences.text: 수업은 오후 두 시에 끝나요.

explanation.en: Class ends at two in the afternoon. 은 marks the topic and 에 marks time.
explanation.zh: “은”标记话题，“에”标记两点这个时间。

sentences.text: 저는 도서관에서 책을 읽어요.

explanation.en: I read a book in the library. 에서 marks the action location and 을 the object.
explanation.zh: “에서”标记阅读发生的地点，“을”标记宾语。

sentences.text: 친구는 식당에서 밥을 먹어요.

explanation.en: My friend eats at the dining hall. 는 marks the topic and 에서 the location of eating.
explanation.zh: “는”引出朋友这个话题，“에서”标记吃饭地点。

questions.prompt: 수업은 언제 끝나요?
친구는 어디에서 밥을 먹어요?
말하는 사람은 무엇을 배우고 있어요?
말하는 사람은 도서관에서 무엇을 해요?
도서관에 있는 사람과 식당에 있는 사람은 같아요?
choices: 네, 두 사람 모두 도서관에서 밥을 먹어요
네, 두 사람 모두 식당에서 책을 읽어요
아니요, 말하는 사람은 도서관에 있고 친구는 식당에 있어요

questions.prompt: 수업이 끝나는 때는 정오 전인가요, 후인가요?

sentences.text: 지금 친구와 여행 계획을 세우고 있어요.

explanation.en: I am making travel plans with a friend now. 고 있어요 describes the ongoing action.
explanation.zh: “고 있어요”表示正在制定计划。

sentences.text: 지난번에는 비가 와서 바다에 못 갔어요.

explanation.en: Last time we could not go to the sea because it rained. 와서 links cause and result.
explanation.zh: “와서”连接下雨这个原因与未能去海边的结果。

sentences.text: 이번에는 지난번보다 날씨가 더 좋을 것 같아요.

explanation.en: I think the weather will be better this time than last time. 보다 marks comparison and 것 같아요 an expectation.
explanation.zh: “보다”用于和上次比较，“것 같아요”表示推测。

sentences.text: 그래서 기차를 타고 바다에 가고 싶어요.

explanation.en: So I want to go to the sea by train. 고 싶어요 expresses a wish.
explanation.zh: “고 싶어요”表示想去海边的愿望。

questions.prompt: 지난번에 바다에 못 간 이유는 뭐예요?
이번에는 어떻게 가고 싶어요?
지금 누구와 여행 계획을 세우고 있어요?
이번에 가고 싶은 곳은 어디예요?
이번 날씨를 어떻게 예상하고 있어요?
「가고 싶어요」는 무엇을 나타내요?

sentences.text: 이 프로젝트는 규모가 작은 반면에 해결해야 할 문제가 많습니다.

explanation.en: This project is small in scale, but there are many problems to solve. 반면에 contrasts the two facts.
explanation.zh: “반면에”对比项目规模小和待解决问题多。

sentences.text: 모든 직원이 같은 방법에 동의하는 것은 아닙니다.

explanation.en: Not all staff agree on the same method. 것은 아닙니다 gives a partial negation.
explanation.zh: “것은 아닙니다”表示不是所有员工都同意同一种方法。

sentences.text: 의견이 다르더라도 서로의 설명을 끝까지 들어야 합니다.

explanation.en: Even when opinions differ, we must listen to one another’s explanations to the end. 더라도 introduces a concession.
explanation.zh: “더라도”表示即使意见不同，也应听完对方解释。

sentences.text: 예산이 줄어들어 일정은 조정할 수밖에 없지만, 중요한 검토 과정은 유지하기로 했습니다.

explanation.en: A smaller budget leaves no choice but to adjust the schedule, but we decided to retain the important review process. 수밖에 없다 means there is no alternative.
explanation.zh: “수밖에 없다”说明别无选择；句子同时说明保留重要审查流程。

questions.prompt: 일정을 조정하는 이유는 무엇입니까?
직원들의 의견에 대한 설명으로 맞는 것은 무엇입니까?
choices: 모두 같은 방법에 동의하는 것은 아닙니다

questions.prompt: 프로젝트의 규모와 문제의 관계는 어떻습니까?
의견이 다를 때 직원들은 어떻게 해야 합니까?
예산이 줄어도 유지하기로 한 것은 무엇입니까?
본문의 대응을 가장 잘 요약한 것은 무엇입니까?

sentences.text: Me llamo Elena y soy estudiante.

explanation.en: My name is Elena and I am a student. Soy introduces an identity.
explanation.zh: “soy”介绍身份。

sentences.text: Hoy estoy en casa con mi hermano.

explanation.en: Today I am at home with my brother. Estoy indicates location.
explanation.zh: “estoy”在这里说明所在位置。

sentences.text: Él prepara una ensalada y yo escribo un mensaje.

explanation.en: He prepares a salad and I write a message. Prepara and escribo agree with different subjects.
explanation.zh: 两个主语对应不同的现在时动词形式。

sentences.text: Después comemos juntos en la cocina.

explanation.en: Afterwards we eat together in the kitchen. Comemos is the first-person plural.
explanation.zh: “comemos”是第一人称复数形式，表示我们一起吃饭。

questions.prompt: ¿Quién prepara la ensalada?
¿Dónde comen?
¿Cuál es la ocupación de Elena?
¿Con quién está Elena hoy?
¿Qué hace Elena mientras su hermano prepara la ensalada?
¿Qué hacen después de preparar la comida y escribir?
choices: Van a estudiar a la biblioteca

sentences.text: Ayer olvidé mi mochila en el autobús.

explanation.en: Yesterday I left my backpack on the bus. Olvidé presents a completed past event.
explanation.zh: “olvidé”说明昨天发生并结束的事件。

sentences.text: Cuando era pequeño, perdía cosas con frecuencia, pero ahora suelo ser más cuidadoso.

explanation.en: When I was little, I often lost things, but now I am usually more careful. Era and perdía describe a past state and habit.
explanation.zh: “era”和“perdía”描述过去的状态与习惯。

sentences.text: Llamé a la oficina de objetos perdidos para preguntar por ella.

explanation.en: I called the lost-property office to ask about it. Para introduces the purpose.
explanation.zh: “para”引出打电话的目的。

sentences.text: La encontraron debajo de un asiento y fui a recogerla por la tarde.

explanation.en: They found it under a seat, and I went to collect it in the afternoon. La refers to the feminine mochila.
explanation.zh: “la”指代阴性名词“mochila”；“por la tarde”表示在下午。

questions.prompt: ¿Dónde olvidó la mochila?
¿Para qué llamó a la oficina?
¿Dónde encontraron la mochila dentro del autobús?
¿Cuándo fue a recoger la mochila?
choices: Antes de llamar a la oficina

questions.prompt: ¿Qué diferencia señala entre su infancia y el presente?
choices: Antes perdía cosas a menudo; ahora suele tener más cuidado
Antes nunca perdía nada; ahora pierde todo a diario
Antes y ahora dice que siempre tiene exactamente el mismo cuidado

questions.prompt: ¿A qué se refiere 'ella' en 'para preguntar por ella'?

sentences.text: El ayuntamiento quiere que los vecinos participen en el diseño de una nueva plaza.

explanation.en: The town council wants residents to help design a new square. Quiere que is followed by the subjunctive participen.
explanation.zh: “quiere que”后用虚拟式“participen”表达愿望。

sentences.text: Aunque el proyecto cuenta con apoyo, algunos comerciantes temen perder clientes durante las obras.

explanation.en: Although the project has support, some shopkeepers fear losing customers during construction. Aunque introduces a concession.
explanation.zh: “aunque”引出让步；后半句说明商家的担忧。

sentences.text: Si las obras duraran menos, las molestias serían menores.

explanation.en: If the work lasted less time, the disruption would be smaller. Duraran and serían form a hypothetical condition.
explanation.zh: 未完成过去虚拟式与条件式配合，描述假设情况。

sentences.text: Se organizarán reuniones para que se escuchen distintas propuestas antes de tomar una decisión.

explanation.en: Meetings will be organized so that different proposals can be heard before a decision is made. Se forms a passive construction; para que takes the subjunctive.
explanation.zh: “se”用于被动表达；“para que”后接虚拟式说明目的。

questions.prompt: ¿Qué temen algunos comerciantes?
choices: Que la plaza sea demasiado antigua

questions.prompt: ¿Para qué se organizarán reuniones?
choices: Para escuchar propuestas antes de decidir
Para anunciar una decisión ya definitiva

questions.prompt: ¿En qué quiere el ayuntamiento que participen los vecinos?
choices: En el diseño de una nueva plaza
En la elección de los clientes de cada comercio
En el cierre definitivo de las tiendas

questions.prompt: ¿Qué relación plantea la frase 'Si las obras duraran menos, las molestias serían menores'?
choices: Las obras ya han terminado sin molestias
Una duración menor reduciría las molestias en esa situación hipotética
Una duración menor aumentaría necesariamente las molestias

questions.prompt: ¿Cuándo se prevé escuchar las distintas propuestas?
choices: Cuando hayan terminado todas las obras
Solo después de una decisión definitiva

questions.prompt: ¿Qué se puede afirmar sobre el apoyo al proyecto?
choices: Existe apoyo, pero algunos comerciantes expresan preocupación
